CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Regency Area hereinafter referred to as Area is the Majalengka Regency Area.
2. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of the Regional Government administration that leads the implementation of governmental affairs which are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regent is the Regent of Majalengka.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional House of Representatives of Majalengka Regency.
5. Regional Apparatus is
5. Regional Apparatus is a supporting element of the Regent and DPRD in administering governmental affairs which are the authority of the region.
6. Administration is the implementation of a matter carried out to achieve a goal.
7. Discrimination is any distinction, harassment or exclusion, direct or indirect, based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, ethnicity, race, ethnic group, social status, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs that result in reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and fundamental freedoms in life, both individual and collective, in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural and other aspects of life.
8. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes deprivation of a person's freedom.
9. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, economic or social exploitation, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom arbitrarily, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life.
10. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, economic or social exploitation, including neglect and ill-treatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child.
11. Violence against women and children in the household is any act against a woman and child that results in suffering or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically, economically and/or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or deprivation of freedom unlawfully within the scope of the household.
12. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruiting, transporting, harboring, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, fraud, deception and abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person who has control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in a person being exploited.
13. Child is a person who is not yet 18 (eighteen) years old including a child who is still in the womb.
14. Child marriage is a marriage conducted through civil, religious or customary law with or without official registration or consent where one or both partners are children under the age of 18 years.
15. Woman is a person (human) who has a vagina, can menstruate, become pregnant, give birth to children, and breastfeed.
16. Victim
16. Victim of violence is an individual or group of people who experience physical, mental or emotional suffering, economic loss, or experience neglect, reduction or deprivation of their basic rights, as a result of human rights violations, or criminal acts and acts of violence committed either by state apparatus or by the state or Regional Government apparatus or by individuals, including victims are their heirs.
17. Protection is a series of fulfillment of the rights of women and child victims of violence and discrimination starting from prevention, handling and empowerment efforts.
18. Prevention is an effort made by the Regional Government to prevent acts of violence against women and children. 19. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a regional technical implementation unit established by the Regional Government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection, and other problems.
20. Regional Long-Term Development Plan hereinafter referred to as RPJPD is a regional development planning document for a period of 20 (twenty) years.
21. Regional Medium-Term Development Plan hereinafter referred to as RPJMD is a regional planning document for a period of 5 (five) years.
22. Task Force for the Prevention and Handling of Trafficking in Persons hereinafter referred to as Task Force is a coordinating institution tasked with coordinating prevention and handling efforts for trafficking in persons in Majalengka Regency.
23. Parents are biological father and/or mother, or step father and/or mother, or adoptive father and/or mother.
24. Family is a person who has blood relations in a straight line upward or downward and collateral lines up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is a dependent of a woman and/or child.
25. Community is individuals, families, groups, and social organizations and/or community organizations.
26. Child-Friendly Regency is a regency that has a child rights-based development system through the integration of government commitment and resources, community, business world and media that is planned comprehensively and sustainably in policies, programs and activities to ensure the fulfillment of children's rights and special protection of children.
27. Private Sector is Non-Governmental Institutions, Business World and Mass Media.

Part Two

Obligations and Responsibilities of the Private Sector and Community

Article15

(1) The obligations and responsibilities of the private sector and community as referred to in Article 13 letters b and c, are implemented in the form of participation of the private sector and community.

(2) The forms of participation of the private sector and community as referred to in paragraph (1),include:

a. preventing acts of violence against women and children; b. providing information and/or reporting acts of violence against women and children to law enforcement or authorized parties; and
c. participating in handling victims of violence.
(3) The forms of participation of the private sector and community as referred to in paragraph (2), are carried out responsibly in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATIONOFPROTECTIONOFWOMENANDCHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

II. ARTICLEBYBTICLE

Part Three

Obligations and Responsibilities of the Family and/or Parents Article16

The obligations of the family and/or parents as referred to in Article 13 letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

Article 5

Physical violence as referred to in Article 4 letter a is an act that results in pain accompanied by injury, wounds or defects on the body, miscarriage, fainting and/or causing death of women and/or children.

Article 6

Psychological violence as referred to in Article 4 letter b is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, a sense of helplessness and/or psychological suffering in women and/or children.

Article8

Neglect as referred to in Article 4 letter d includes: a. acts of deliberately neglecting a woman within the scope of her household, whereas according to the law applicable to her or by agreement or contract she is obliged to provide life and care to said woman.

b. acts resulting in the failure to fulfill the reasonable needs of a child, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social, committed by parents, guardians, or any other party responsible for their care;

c. acts of deliberately neglecting to care for or look after a child as appropriate, committed by parents, guardians, or any other party responsible for their care.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

IMPLEMENTATIONOFPROTECTIONOFWOMENANDCHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

Article9

b. acts with or without the victim's consent which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting a person's energy or capability by another party to obtain material or immaterial benefits;

Article 10

(1) Other violence as referred to in Article 4 letter f constitutes threats of violence and coercion.

(2) Threats of violence as referred to in paragraph (1)include any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom.

(3) Coercion as referred to in paragraph (1)includes a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something contrary to their own will.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATIONOFPROTECTIONOFWOMENANDCHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

Violence against women and children in the household is any act against a woman and child that results in suffering or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically, economically and/or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or deprivation of freedom unlawfully within the scope of the household.
12. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruiting, transporting, harboring, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, fraud, deception and abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person who has control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in a person being exploited.

26. Child-Friendly Regency is a regency that has a child rights-based development system through the integration of government commitment and resources, community, business world and media that is planned comprehensively and sustainably in policies, programs and activities to ensure the fulfillment of children's rights and special protection of children.
27. Private Sector is Non-Governmental Institutions, Business World and Mass Media.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

Child-Friendly Regency is a regency that has a child rights-based development system through the integration of government commitment and resources, community, business world and media that is planned comprehensively and sustainably in policies, programs and activities to ensure the fulfillment of children's rights and special protection of children.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATIONOFPROTECTIONOFWOMENANDCHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATIONOFPROTECTIONOFWOMENANDCHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

Article9

Exploitation as referred to in Article 4 letter e includes: a. acts of economic or sexual exploitation with the intent to benefit oneself or others;

b. acts with or without the victim's consent which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting a person's energy or capability by another party to obtain material or immaterial benefits;

Article 10

(1) Other violence as referred to in Article 4 letter f constitutes threats of violence and coercion.

(2) Threats of violence as referred to in paragraph (1)include any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom.

(3) Coercion as referred to in paragraph (1)includes a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something contrary to their own will.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATIONOFPROTECTIONOFWOMENANDCHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

The obligations of the family and/or parents as referred to in Article 13 letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

CONCERNING

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

(1) Other violence as referred to in Article 4 letter f constitutes threats of violence and coercion.

IMPLEMENTATIONOFPROTECTIONOFWOMENANDCHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

(2) The forms of participation of the private sector and community as referred to in paragraph (1),include:

a. preventing acts of violence against women and children; b. providing information and/or reporting acts of violence against women and children to law enforcement or authorized parties; and
c. participating in handling victims of violence.
(3) The forms of participation of the private sector and community as referred to in paragraph (2), are carried out responsibly in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

II. ARTICLEBYBTICLE

Article27

(1) In the framework of implementing the Convention on the Rights of the Child and various laws and regulations as well as policies related to the fulfillment of children's rights and special protection of children, the Regional Government, Private Sector and Community Organizations make efforts to realize a Child-Friendly Regency.

(2) To realize a Child-Friendly Regency as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Government, Private Sector and Community Organizations pay attention to children's rights related to the right to life, growth and development, protection and participation.

(3)

The Regional Government, Private Sector and Community Organizations in realizing a Child-Friendly Regency are incorporated in the Child-Friendly Regency Task Force.

(4) The Child-Friendly Regency Task Force as referred to in paragraph (3) is responsible for the fulfillment of children's rights related to:

a. civil rights and freedoms;
b. family environment and alternative care;
c. basic health and welfare;
d. education 15
d. education, use of leisure time and cultural activities; e. special protection of children.
(5) Further provisions regarding Child-Friendly Regency shall be regulated in Regent Regulation.

Article9

Exploitation as referred to in Article 4 letter e includes: a. acts of economic or sexual exploitation with the intent to benefit oneself or others;

b. acts with or without the victim's consent which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting a person's energy or capability by another party to obtain material or immaterial benefits;

Article 10

(1) Other violence as referred to in Article 4 letter f constitutes threats of violence and coercion.

(2) Threats of violence as referred to in paragraph (1)include any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom.

(3) Coercion as referred to in paragraph (1)includes a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something contrary to their own will.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATIONOFPROTECTIONOFWOMENANDCHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

CONCERNING

IMPLEMENTATIONOFPROTECTIONOFWOMENANDCHILDREN

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

a. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget (APBD); and
b. other sources that are legal and non-binding.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.

Discrimination is any distinction, harassment or exclusion, direct or indirect, based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, ethnicity, race, ethnic group, social status, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs that result in reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and fundamental freedoms in life, both individual and collective, in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural and other aspects of life.
8. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or causes deprivation of a person's freedom.

Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or suffering of women physically, sexually or psychologically, economic or social exploitation, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of freedom arbitrarily, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life.

Violence against women and children in the household is any act against a woman and child that results in suffering or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically, economically and/or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or deprivation of freedom unlawfully within the scope of the household.
12. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruiting, transporting, harboring, sending, transferring, or receiving a person by threat of violence, use of violence, abduction, confinement, fraud, deception and abuse of power or vulnerable position, debt bondage or giving payment or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person who has control over that other person, whether carried out within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in a person being exploited.

I. GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex in line with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of the Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One effort to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously owned potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as women to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their families.

Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector holistically and inseparably from one another. Community service is the front line when there is potential for violence against children. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. Such efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.

In connection with the above, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence and for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional territory, it is necessary to regulate in a Regional Regulation.
